$comment: Work-Atom return contract, per ADR-029. This file is the contract of record; bin/validate-return-contract.sh hardcodes the same rules.
title: Work-Atom Return Contract
description: Structured return payload every Work-Atom worker emits back to the orchestrator.

atom_id.description: Identifier of the atom this return belongs to (e.g. A4-01).

result.description: What was produced. Concrete, not aspirational.

evidence.description: Observable proof supporting the result (command output, file excerpt, diff hunk).

check.description: The runnable check that was executed.

detail.description: Optional detail on the check outcome.

verify.description: Self-verification record: the check run and its outcome.

files_touched.description: Absolute paths of files created or modified.

followups.description: Follow-up work items surfaced by this atom.

trace_id.description: Correlation id tying this return to the orchestrator's dispatch record.
